name: Fish
description: Guidelines for traveling with fish in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Live fish in water in a clear, spill-proof container are allowed in carry-on. Declare them at security for visual inspection.

checkedBag.reason: Live fish in water cannot go in checked baggage due to lack of pressure/temperature safety.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring fish on a plane?

travelTips: Live fish in water in a clear, spill-proof container are allowed in carry-on. Declare them at security for visual inspection.

faq.question: Is fish allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Fish is allowed in carry-on luggage. Live fish in water in a clear, spill-proof container are allowed in carry-on. Declare them at security for visual inspection.

faq.question: Can you pack fish in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Fish is not allowed in checked bags. Live fish in water cannot go in checked baggage due to lack of pressure/temperature safety.
